title: Integrative analysis of mitochondrial metabolic dynamics in reprogramming human fibroblast cells
protocol: Seed human fibroblasts onto wells B-G of the XF HS miniplate containing 100 μL of fibroblast medium at 5-6 × 10^3 cells/well (∼90% confluency).
Incubate the XF HS miniplate in a 5% CO2 37°C incubator for 18–24 h.
Put cartridges into the laminar flow hood.
Separate the sensor cartridge from the utility plate and place the sensor cartridge upside down.
Add 200 μL of XF Calibrant solution into each well of the Utility plate.
Add 400 μL of XF Calibrant solution into the moat chambers around the outside of the wells.
Return the XF Sensor cartridge to the Utility plate containing XF Calibrant solution.
Place the cartridge assembly in a non-CO2 37°C incubator for 18–24 h.
Keep the non-CO2 37°C incubator humidified at 100%.
Prepare an XF HS miniplate for the assay.
Verify cell condition in the XF HS miniplate before starting the assay.
Turn on the XF HS Mini Analyzer at least 1 hour before the experiment.
Prepare 5 mL of XF assay medium for each 8-well XF HS miniplate.
Warm up the XF assay medium in a 37°C water bath.
Aspirate fibroblast media from the XF HS miniplate without disturbing cells.
Wash each well of the XF HS miniplate twice with 180 μL of XF assay medium.
Add 180 μL of XF assay medium into each well of the XF HS miniplate.
Incubate the XF HS miniplate in a non-CO2 37°C incubator for 1 hour.
Reconstitute compounds with pre-warmed XF assay medium after 20 minutes.
Dilute reconstituted compounds with pre-warmed XF assay medium.
Load diluted compounds into the indicated ports of the hydrated sensor cartridge.
Add 20 μL of diluted oligomycin solution into Port A of the hydrated sensor cartridge.
Add 22 μL of diluted FCCP solution into Port B of the hydrated sensor cartridge.
Add 25 μL of diluted rotenone/antimycin A solution into Port C of the hydrated sensor cartridge.
Hit ‘START’ and run the ‘Mito Stress Test’ program of the XF HS Mini Analyzer.
Place the compounds-loaded, hydrated sensor cartridge assembly onto the load position of XF HS Mini Analyzer.
Once the calibration step of the hydrated sensor cartridge is completed, switch the Utility plate with the XF HS miniplate containing cells and click ‘CONTINUE’.
Take out the assayed XF HS miniplate from the cartridge-miniplate assembly once the assay is completed.
Carefully aspirate the medium from each well of the miniplate without disturbing the attached cells.
Wash out the cells with 200 μL of DPBS once.
Add 200 μL of Bradford dye reagent into each well of the miniplate.
Mix well to prepare a crude cell lysate.
Measure optical density of each sample with a spectrometer to assess protein concentration.
Analyze raw data using the Seahorse WAVE Desktop software.
Plate fibroblasts onto a 4-chamber cell culture slide at 2.5∼3 × 10^5 cells/well (∼80% confluency).
Incubate in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C for 18–24 h.
Wash out the chamber slide containing fibroblasts with 1 mL of DPBS twice.
Aspirate the DPBS and fix the cells with 0.5 mL of 10% formaldehyde solution for 10 min.
Aspirate the formaldehyde solution and wash the cells three times for 10 min with 1 mL of DPBS.
If not staining immediately, fill the chamber slide with 1 mL of DPBS, seal with parafilm, and store at 4°C for up to 1 week.
Aspirate the DPBS and incubate the cells with 1 mL of blocking solution for 30 min.
Aspirate the blocking solution and incubate the cells with anti-TOM20 antibody in blocking solution at 4°C for 18–24 h on a shaker.
Next day, aspirate the diluted antibody solution and wash the cells three times for 10 min with 1 mL of washing solution.
Aspirate the washing solution and incubate the cells with anti-mouse secondary antibody in blocking solution for 1 h on a shaker at room temperature (15°C–30°C).
Aspirate the diluted antibody solution and wash the cells three times for 10 min with 1 mL of washing solution.
Incubate the cells with 500 μL of Hoechst 33342 in DPBS for 5 min at room temperature (15°C–30°C).
Aspirate the diluted Hoechst 33342 solution and wash the cells three times for 10 min with 1 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate the DPBS, remove the chamber from the slide.
Apply one drop of Fluoroshield solution onto the slide.
Cover the slide with a microscope cover glass.
Image the slide under a fluorescence microscope.
Download and install Fiji distribution of ImageJ2 software.
Install the Mitochondrial Network Analysis (MiNA) toolset.
Perform the ‘MiNA Analyze Morphology’ script by navigating to the ‘StuartLab’ under the ‘Plugins’ menu.
Set up ‘Unsharp Mask’ as 1st place in preprocessing settings.
Set up ‘Enhance Local Contrast CLAHE’ as 2nd place.
Set up ‘Median Filter’ as 3rd place.
Select ‘Preview Preprocessing’ function to review adjustments.
Press the ‘OK’ button to execute the script.
Collect cells grown on a 6 cm tissue culture dish at ∼80% confluency using TrypLE™ express enzyme solution.
Spin down the collected cells at 200 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the medium and wash the cells twice with 1 mL of DPBS.
Incubate the cells with MitoTracker™ Green FM (150 nM in DPBS) for 25 min at 37°C.
Spin down the cells after incubation at 200 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the MitoTracker™ Green FM solution and wash the cells twice with 1 mL of DPBS.
Reconstitute the washed cells with 1 mL of DPBS.
Measure mitochondrial mass using a MACSQuant® Analyzer 16.
Analyze raw data using FlowJo.
Collect cells grown on 6 cm tissue culture dish using TryPLE™ express enzyme solution when they are approximately 80% confluent.
Spin down the collected cells at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Wash the cells with 1 ml of DPBS twice.
Incubate the cells with JC-1 cationic dye (10 μg/mL in DPBS) for 10 minutes at 37°C.
Spin down the cells at 200 × g for 3 minutes after incubation.
Wash the cells with 1 ml of DPBS twice.
Reconstitute the cells with 1 ml of DPBS.
Measure mitochondrial membrane potential using MACSQuant® Analyzer 16.
Analyze raw data using FlowJo.
Collect cells grown on a 6 cm tissue culture dish at approximately 80% confluency.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL conical tube and spin down the cells at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the medium and resuspend the cells with 1 mL of DPBS.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and spin down the cells at 6,000 × g for 1 minute.
Aspirate the DPBS and lyse the cells with 100 μL of 1× Cell Lysis buffer on ice for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the lysed cells at 15,000 × g, 4°C for 10 minutes.
Transfer the lysate carefully into a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube without disturbing the cell pellet and store the samples on ice.
Measure the protein concentration of the samples with a spectrometer using a Bradford assay.
Add 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 μL of diluted standard solution into a series of standards wells on a 96-well microplate.
Add 50 μL of Assay buffer into the wells of the 96-well microplate containing the standards.
Adjust the volume to 50 μL/well by adding more Assay buffer if necessary.
Add 1–50 μL of samples into duplicate wells of the 96-well microplate.
Adjust the sample well volumes to 50 μL by adding appropriate amounts of Assay buffer.
Add 50 μL of Reaction mix solution to each well containing standards and samples.
Incubate the microplate in a non-CO2 37°C incubator for 30 min.
Measure the OD values of samples on a microplate reader at 450 nm for malate, 570 nm for citrate, α-ketoglutarate, and oxaloacetate.
For kinetic readings, repeat the microplate incubation at 37°C.
Incubate the plate at intervals up to 1 hour.
Measure the OD values every 20 min during incubation.
Calculate metabolite concentrations of each sample from the standard curve data.
Determine Ay (amount of metabolite in samples) and Sy (amount of samples added).
Calculate C using the formula C = Ay / Sy (nmol/μg protein).
Present the data as heatmaps, scatter plots, or bar charts.
